paper_title: Shining Light on the Dark Sector: Search for Axion-like Particles and Other New Physics in Photonic Final States with FASER
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (ALP-photon interpretation, Fig. 11 left); note primary result is g_aWW in GeV^-1
notes: FASER search for long-lived particles decaying to two photons using 57.7 fb^-1 of 13.6 TeV pp data. The PRIMARY target is an ALP coupled to weak gauge bosons (g_aWW in GeV^-1), which has no exact match in the enum. The paper also provides reinterpretations for ALP-photon (g_agamma, GeV^-1, Fig. 11 left), ALP-gluon, U(1)_B gauge boson, up-philic scalar, 2HDM, and dark photon. Exclusion limits are at 90% C.L. (CLs). Text gives ALP-W numbers: masses 100-250 MeV excluded for g_aWW = 3e-5 to 5e-4 GeV^-1; mass up to 300 MeV (3e8 eV) excluded at g_aWW = 2e-5 GeV^-1. No precise numerical (mass,coupling) pairs are available for the ALP-photon interpretation in the provided text—limits are presented only as contour plots (Fig. 11). This is a collider/beam-dump-style production search, not a DM haloscope, so no DM density applies.
